premises.text: Children socialize heavily on connected devices, and new technology creates new online risks such as harmful messages
Parents' only options today are manually scanning phones or spot-checking with saved passwords, which undermines independence and is daily friction
premises.evidence_span: my only options are to pick up his phone, scan through his messages, or to save his passwords and randomly spot check his activity online

premises.text: Bark uses machine learning on social and message content to detect issues like cyberbullying, sexting, and depression/suicide signs, alerting parents with recommended actions without unfettered message access
premises.evidence_span: we've developed machine learning-based algorithms to detect issues like cyberbullying, sexting, signs of depression or suicide

premises.text: Bark costs $9 per month per family for unlimited children and accounts, with an affiliate model for schools and nonprofits
premises.evidence_span: BARC is just $9 per month per family, unlimited children, unlimited connected accounts

value.text: Keep children safe online while preserving privacy and building family trust
